historyTimeline.h2: Range Rover 5.0 SC - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: When the 5.0 SC variant launched, it marked the introduction of the all-aluminium AJ133 supercharged V8, replacing the older 4.2L unit and delivering a massive leap in performance and refinement for the flagship Range Rover.

milestones.description: AJ133 (5.0L Supercharged V8), 510hp, introduced in the late L322 generation, featuring a Roots-type supercharger and direct injection.
Carried over to the all-new L405 generation with revised engine mounts, updated ECU mapping, and improved thermal management for the supercharger.
Minor calibration updates to meet stricter WLTP emissions standards while maintaining the 510hp output across the L405 lifecycle.

historyTimeline.closingNote: Every engine fitted to the Range Rover 5.0 SC is covered below, with UK rebuilt pricing and known failure points.

commonProblems.h2: Range Rover 5.0 SC Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The Range Rover 5.0 SC (AJ133) is a high-performance powerhouse, but its complex supercharged architecture is susceptible to specific cooling and timing chain issues. Rebuilt engines through EnginesMarket include upgraded components addressing these original failure points, plus a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: Timing Chain & Tensioner Wear - Why the Range Rover 5.0 SC AJ133 Requires Attention
problems.rootCause: Early hydraulic tensioners can wear prematurely, leading to chain stretch and a distinct rattling noise on cold starts, which can cause catastrophic internal damage if ignored.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replacing chains, guides, and installing upgraded tensioners.
repairOptions.longevity: Effective if caught early before valve/piston damage occurs.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, upgraded components addressing the original failure point, 12-month warranty.
repairOptions.longevity: The right call if chain failure has caused catastrophic internal damage.

problems.recommendation: For the Range Rover 5.0 SC, preventative replacement of the coolant crossover pipes and early inspection of the timing chain tensioners is highly cost-effective. However, if you are experiencing timing chain rattle or have suffered catastrophic internal failure, a reconditioned AJ133 engine with upgraded tensioners and cooling components is the safest long-term solution to preserve performance and value.

problems.h4: Coolant Crossover Pipe Leaks - Why the Range Rover 5.0 SC AJ133 Overheats
problems.rootCause: The plastic coolant crossover pipes located in the "hot-vee" of the V8 degrade over time due to extreme thermal cycling, leading to coolant loss and potential overheating.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replacing plastic crossover pipes with revised components and flushing the system.
repairOptions.longevity: Highly recommended preventative measure to avoid catastrophic thermal damage.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, upgraded components addressing the original failure point, 12-month warranty.
repairOptions.longevity: Necessary if severe overheating has led to warped cylinder heads or seized components.
